run_gen_negatives: run the threaded negative caption generation pipeline for all dense captioned images up to IDX_TARGET
get_n_negatives_per: generate N negative captions of basic, layout, and swap types for a given input caption using a remote language model
gen_negatives_for: generate negative captions for a single dense captioned image index including base and all mask-level captions
negatives_len_fit: check whether all generated negative captions fit within the 77 token CLIP limit
thread_entry: process a queue of image indices and generate negative captions concurrently, saving results to JSON files
